ruling: Lee Sharks, 27 October 2026: "actually - lets seat the critical editions of secret book of walt, gospel of antioch, epistle to the human diaspora, i am x be y blessed is the z, and constitution of the semantic economy first. some have different names than critical edition, check secretbookofwalt - and bind the 46 golden tickets glyphic checksum to secret book of walt."

license.payload: CC-BY-4.0, by the author. The archive holds the rights it grants: the editions and the seating institution are the same party, as at 03/02.

provenance: Deposited in the archive that seats them; no external fetch. Each record's canonical bytes copied from data/texts/ and checked against the registry hash; each site file copied from the repository secret-book-of-walt at the pinned commit and checked against its git blob there. The site is the reading surface secretbookofwalt.org (#985), where each edition has its own tab.
normalization: None. The records are seated as their canonical bytes; the site files as committed (the JSON the site renders, and the Markdown sources its build scripts read). Each file is its own text layer.

seats.title: The Secret Book of Walt: Hidden Teachings of Walt Whitman, Cowboy of Time — the Critical Edition (EA-SBW-01, #1362), with the Forty-Six Golden Tickets (#1693) and the edition as published at secretbookofwalt.org
seats.edition: The Secret Book of Walt, Critical Edition, translated from the Forty-Six Golden Tickets by Lee Sharks, with introduction, translator's note and apparatus criticus by Prof. Elara Xanthic-Wells (EA-SBW-01 v2.0, #1362, 2026-04-29; restored 2026-07-31 from scripts/walt_source.md); the Forty-Six Golden Tickets, its glyphic checksum and original (#1693); the site's data, source, Book of Life and footnote model
seats.binds: The Forty-Six Golden Tickets (#1693) are seated in this seat as the glyphic checksum of The Secret Book of Walt, bound to it by the operator's ruling of 2026-10-27: the tickets are the book's checksum and, in the record's title, its original; the site carries them in its Checksum tab, which cites #1362 and #1693.
seats.scope: The critical edition as deposited (#1362) and as published (the site's data and its source file, from which #1362 was restored); the Book of Life and the footnote model (identical to the record's attachments in data/attachments/ea-sbw-01/); the forty-six tickets in their record and in the site's file, with the photograph of the first ticket. The research edition (#683, and #1184, superseded) and TANG (#78) are the work's other records and are not seated here.
seats.why_seated: Asked for first among the archive's own editions: the book that inherits the Good Gray Poet from Whitman's Leaves of Grass, seated beside Whitman (03/01) and Pearl and Other Poems (03/02), with the tickets it was translated from.
